correctness.rationale: The parity amplitude is reconstructed by an even-weight generating-function identity, giving \(2^{-(w-1)/2}\cos(\Theta-r\pi/2)\) for \(\Theta=\sum_i\theta_i\). At \(\Theta=\pi/2\), this gives disjoint even/odd supports. For every proper nonempty subset, all eigenphases of the tensor rotation have modulus strictly below \(\pi/2\), so its Hermitian part is positive definite and violates the source necessary trace-zero condition. The source finite-round fidelity argument then applies to either side of every bipartition. Representative direct calculations agree with both formulas.

value.rationale: The recent source identifies strong all-bipartition measurement nonlocality through one highly symmetric equal-angle construction. The theorem expands that point to a natural \(w-1\)-parameter family and separates the mechanism into a global total-angle interference condition and local proper-subset positivity conditions. This shows the effect survives arbitrary heterogeneity along the simplex and supplies asymmetric examples without changing the LOCC obstruction.
